CLAIM RELEASED (C03 revision 1 handoff)

Session: `ADB991-claude-20261113-80e9`
Claim: https://github.com/hairer/humanise-yang-mills/issues/122#issuecomment-6849004709
Draft PR: #123 (branch `ADB991:claude/issue-122-80e9` @ `df34654`, base `codex/existence-monograph` @ `5ec6941`)

**Established.** Every required change of review PR #77 is answered, either by an edit (M1–M13) or, for the read-only evidence files, by a listed correction (L2–L4). M14 is partly done. The response table is `results/C03/revision-1.md`. Main points:
- `rem:ex-limits-fullmesh` no longer says the main construction skips the mesh selection. It now describes the source route: extract along a mesh subsequence, prove the full-mesh limit separately, identify the two by `ex-full-mesh` (`YM.FullVolume.Final.from_spec`).
- Missing hypotheses that the proofs already used are now stated:
  - (H4)–(H6) in `prop:ex-selected-interpolation`, from `YM.Extra.Histories.Heard` fields `moves`, `book`, `unit`;
  - the supremum bound after transport in `prop:ex-public-origin`;
  - the cutoff-covariance convergence in `ex-ordinary-reflection`, from `YM.Bid.B04`.
- The full-mesh bounds now have an explicit mesh-only preorder, budget quantifiers and a cited centring argument (`ex-centered-producers`).
- The ledger now splits E4 into three parts, defines every edge, splits the C13 edge from a new C09 edge and adds C03-to-C16-full-mesh.

Checks: blueprint checker OK; 22 tests OK; full monograph build exit 0 (961 pp, no undefined references); the changed pages were rendered and inspected. There was no Lean elaboration (Mathlib unreachable). The Lean anchors were checked as source text.

**Uncertain or open.**
- The coupon merger (`YM.Extra.Histories.merge_budget`, `YM.MergeProof.profile_merge`) is now an explicit **outstanding input**. It is stated precisely, but writing its proof needs a manuscript definition of the remainder bound.
- E4 part 2 has no producer statement in the manuscript: the inclusion and derivative maps between grades. The same holds for I-C05-O4, I-C01-slot and the conjugation-fixed basis.
- The cycle checks C03↔C12 and C03↔C09 are not done.
- F4 (duplicate Cauchy treatment) and F5 (Lean vocabulary) wait for G05 (#61).
- `sees` and the `Picks`/`Corrected` anchors are taken from the review's quotations and were not re-read.

**Next.**
1. Renewed independent review (mathematics and Lean correspondence) of the seven changed chapters, at the hashes in `results/C03/validation.md`. It must not be done by this account.
2. Whoever owns the evidence files and the C04 ledger: apply the corrections and the proposed E4 patch in `revision-1.md`.
3. A bounded task for the merger statement and proof, once the remainder-bound definition is fixed (G05 / C08).

Prepared autonomously by Claude (Anthropic) running as a scheduled agent on behalf of @ADB991; ADB991 had not reviewed it before submission.
